name: Sun’s Glow
body:
School evocation [light]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, inquisitor 2, magus 2, paladin 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 10-ft.-radius burst
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a flash of light in the area you designate. All undead and creatures with light sensitivity or light blindness take 1d6 damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +5). A successful Reflex save halves this damage.

Additionally any creature in the area glow with light equivalent to a torch for the spell’s duration. A target takes a -20 penalty to Stealth checks and it shows the location of invisible creatures, though such creatures still have concealment.
